crossRefs.note: The woman took the two men and hid them. Then she said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I didn’t know where they came…
About the time of the shutting of the gate, when it was dark, the men went out. Where the men went, I don’t know.…
The midwives said to Pharaoh, “Because the Hebrew women aren’t like the Egyptian women; for they are vigorous and give…

translations.web: The woman took and spread the covering over the well’s mouth, and spread out crushed grain on it; and nothing was known.
translations.bsb: Then the man’s wife took a covering, spread it over the mouth of the well, and scattered grain over it so nobody would know a thing.
translations.kjv: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well's mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.
translations.asv: And the woman took and spread the covering over the well's mouth, and strewed bruised grain thereon; and nothing was known.
